My dear [Miss Smith](/person/263)
Thanks for the Exhibition - which is full of interest. I wish there was any chance of my seeing it. I like most of what you have said much, though I do not agree with your deprecation of [Dr Hook](/person/709)’s character of Edward VI, for certainly his own journal does not bear out the praises bestowed on him, and it was rather forward to say the least of it in a mere boy to meddle with the convictions of learned men. Thanks much for the whole - it is pleasant reading-
[The rest of the letter is missing]
